in_marathi.name: Naveena
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Young, Fresh, New
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naveena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning new or young. This name symbolizes the new beginnings and fresh starts in life.

in_bengali.name: Naveena
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Young, Fresh, New
in_bengali.long_meaning: Naveena একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning new or young. This name symbolizes the new beginnings and fresh starts in life.
